internal.title: Incident Report: Frontend Service High Error Rate
internal.body:
At 10:30 UTC, an alert was triggered for the frontend service due to a high error rate of 35%. Initial diagnosis identified potential error injection within the frontend and checkout services, with checkout also experiencing high p95 latency of 400ms. Attempts to mitigate by restarting the checkout service were blocked due to missing dry run capabilities in the deployment environment. Multiple replans were made focusing on checkout latency and error injection hypotheses, but no successful mitigation was executed during the incident window. The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution.

Timeline highlights:
- 10:30:40 Alert received for frontend error rate spike
- 10:50:23 Diagnosis round 1 focused on checkout latency
- 10:50:28 and 10:50:40 Proposals to restart checkout service blocked by guardrails
- 10:50:31, 10:50:42, 10:50:49 Multiple replans adjusting hypotheses and mitigation plans

Next steps include deeper root cause analysis and verification of recovery actions.

external.body: Between approximately 10:30 and 10:50 UTC, some customers experienced intermittent errors when using the frontend service. Our engineering team identified increased error rates and latency in related backend services during this period. We escalated the issue for further investigation and are working to prevent recurrence. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
